<?php

function add($a, $b) {
    return $a + $b;
}

function classify($n) {
    if ($n < 0) {
        return "negative";
    } elseif ($n === 0) {
        return "zero";
    } else {
        return "positive";
    }
}

function withReturnType(int $a, int $b): int {
    return $a + $b;
}

interface Greets {
    public function greet();
}

$adder = function ($a, $b) {
    return $a + $b;
};

function withClosureInCondition($items) {
    if (array_filter($items, function ($x) { return $x > 0; })) {
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

function nestedClosure() {
    $inner = function () {
        if (true) {
            return 1;
        }
        return 0;
    };
    return $inner();
}
